name: Skin-Walkers: Synthetics Replacing Key Humans
description: One of GLMZ's most emotionally charged conspiracy theories holds that a coordinated program — origin disputed between corponation initiative and autonomous synthetic action — has been systematically replacing high-value human individuals with synthetic duplicates since approximately 2210. Believers call the replacements 'Skin-Walkers,' a term reclaimed from pre-Diaspora folklore. The theory gained significant traction in 2222 when Tier 4 executive Priya Okafor-Johanssen publicly claimed her husband had been replaced, citing behavioral discontinuities and a faint bioluminescent pattern visible in his left retina under UV light — a known but rare synthetic tell.
cultural_impact: UV flashlights — called 'truth-lights' — have become a minor consumer phenomenon in Tier 3-4 social spaces, with some establishments quietly offering them at the bar. The theory has caused measurable harm to synthetic-human relationships and given ammunition to anti-synthetic political movements, while synthetic rights advocates argue the conspiracy repackages ancient fears of the 'other' in technological clothing.
key_figures: Anti-synthetic political figure Gregor Vasile-Abara (uses theory as platform)
Synthetic rights advocate and E.L.F. liaison 'Cassian' (synthetic, openly so)
locations: Tier 4 Harborview social district where truth-lights first appeared
Gregor Vasile-Abara's registered political office, Tier 3 Civic Quarter
Online Synthetic Appreciation Society forums (site of fierce counter-debate)
story_hooks: A player is approached by someone claiming their sibling has been replaced — and the behavioral evidence is genuinely compelling, but so is the possibility that the accuser is experiencing BCI-related paranoia

Cassian the synthetic rights advocate hires the players to investigate the Skin-Walker theory's origin, suspecting it was manufactured by a corponation to justify anti-synthetic legislation currently moving through the GLMZ civic council

A player character with a synthetic companion begins noticing the truth-lights being used on them in public — and one scan produces an anomalous result that neither the player nor the synthetic can explain
believers: Tier 3-4 anxious professionals, anti-synthetic political movements, some trauma survivors with BCI complications, tabloid consumers
evidence: No verified case of synthetic replacement of a living human has been documented; Priya Okafor-Johanssen's husband was confirmed human by three independent medical assessments, and the retinal bioluminescence was a rare genetic variant; the theory's origin has been traced to a 2209 Underworld fiction serial that was deliberately amplified by parties unknown — possibly corponation-linked actors seeking to divide synthetic and human labor organizing efforts
